assignment: Write a permit-desk decision note on a proposed venue change.
source: The permit covers Hall A until 20:00 for up to 100 attendees. Policy P allows a desk amendment only when venue, hours and capacity all stay within the existing approval. A new review is required for any outdoor venue. Organizers request the courtyard until 19:00 with 80 attendees. An indoor fallback would use Hall A until 19:30 for 90.

criteria.full: Applies the outdoor-venue review trigger despite the earlier finish and lower capacity.
criteria.partial: Focuses on headcount and hours but overlooks the separate outdoor rule.

criteria.full: Checks Hall A, 19:30 and 90 against all three conditions and identifies the desk path.
criteria.partial: Suggests the fallback without checking every condition.

criteria.full: Offers distinct decision paths with review ownership and scheduling implications.
criteria.partial: Issues a blanket decision without a practical next step.

criteria.full: Drafts precise organizer-facing language recording approved conditions and pending courtyard status.
criteria.partial: Promises outdoor approval or leaves the authorized scope ambiguous.
